original_coverage_E: Mumbai City and Mumbai Suburban districts (the whole of Greater Mumbai island city, suburbs and harbour)
coverage_T: India (Maharashtra (Mumbai, Mumbai Suburban ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Now exactly the two Mumbai districts; old 16.7m flat figure replaced by district-based 13.3m. Thane/Navi Mumbai belt moved to seat 27.
notes: Mumbai Suburban borders Thane district by land (Dahisar-Mira Road). Navi Mumbai (Thane/Raigarh districts) not split; ADM2 granularity.

constituency_C: Thane–Palghar (Mumbai Metropolitan Region north and east)
original_coverage_E: Thane and Palghar districts (MMR beyond Mumbai: Thane, Kalyan, Navi Mumbai, Vasai-Virar, Dahanu)
coverage_T: India (Maharashtra (Thane, Palghar ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Renamed Thane-Palghar; Palghar merged in from old seat 28; old 19.3m flat figure replaced.
notes: Thane and Palghar are contiguous (Palghar was split from Thane in 2014; geoBoundaries lists both). Navi Mumbai lies in Thane district.

original_coverage_E: Amravati division of Vidarbha (Buldana, Akola, Washim, Amravati) plus Yavatmal and Wardha districts
coverage_T: India (Maharashtra (Buldana, Akola, Washim, Amravati, Yavatmal, Wardha ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Old seat 28 Palghar-North Konkan redefined as Berar (Palghar moved to seat 27) because the Konkan/Mumbai belt holds only ~35m for seats 26-29 and Vidarbha needed a second seat.
notes: Seat number 28 is geographically out of sequence with the Konkan seats (seat id kept). Buldana=Buldhana, Wardha borders Amravati and Yavatmal.

original_coverage_E: South Konkan (Raigad, Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg) with all of Goa, plus Kolhapur and Sangli districts on the Sahyadri uplands
coverage_T: India (Maharashtra (Raigarh, Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg, Kolhapur, Sangli ADM2 only), Goa [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Goa+Konkan kept together; Kolhapur and Sangli added (from old seat 31) because Konkan+Goa alone is only ~7.3m; old 12.8m figure replaced.
notes: Goa borders Sindhudurg; Sindhudurg-Kolhapur and Ratnagiri-Kolhapur/Sangli linked by Sahyadri ghat roads. Raigarh (Maharashtra) = Raigad, name as in geoBoundaries.

original_coverage_E: Pune and Satara districts (Pune-Pimpri-Chinchwad and the Krishna headwaters)
coverage_T: India (Maharashtra (Pune, Satara ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Satara added; old 15.8m flat figure replaced (Pune district alone ~13.6m).
notes: Pune and Satara are contiguous.

original_coverage_E: Solapur, Ahmednagar (Ahilyanagar), Beed and Osmanabad (Dharashiv) districts of the Deccan interior
coverage_T: India (Maharashtra (Solapur, Ahmadnagar, Osmanabad, Bid ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Renamed (old: Kolhapur / Western Maharashtra); Kolhapur+Sangli moved to seat 29, Satara to seat 30; Ahmednagar, Beed and Osmanabad added so Marathwada seat is not oversized.
notes: Beed and Osmanabad belong to Marathwada culturally; placed here for population balance (Marathwada total ~22m). Names Ahmadnagar, Bid, Osmanabad follow geoBoundaries.

original_coverage_E: Nashik division of north Maharashtra: Nashik, Dhule, Nandurbar and Jalgaon districts
coverage_T: India (Maharashtra (Nashik, Dhule, Nandurbar, Jalgaon ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Old flat 14.4m figure replaced.
notes: Contiguous.

original_coverage_E: Marathwada core: Aurangabad (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar), Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Parbhani, Hingoli
coverage_T: India (Maharashtra (Aurangabad, Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Parbhani, Hingoli ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Beed and Osmanabad moved to seat 31 for balance.
notes: Contiguous. Aurangabad is the geoBoundaries spelling.

original_coverage_E: East Vidarbha (Nagpur, Bhandara, Gondiya, Gadchiroli, Chandrapur) plus the adjoining Satpura/Gondwana districts of Madhya Pradesh: Balaghat, Seoni, Chhindwara
coverage_T: India (Maharashtra (Nagpur, Bhandara, Gondiya, Gadchiroli, Chandrapur ADM2 only), Madhya Pradesh (Balaghat, Seoni, Chhindwara ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Wardha, Yavatmal and the Amravati division moved to new Berar seat 28; Balaghat, Seoni and Chhindwara (MP) added.
notes: Cross-state block within India: Balaghat/Seoni/Chhindwara share the Gondwana/Wainganga-Pench culture and Marathi-Gondi borderland with Gondiya/Bhandara/Nagpur; needed to ease MP population (MP total ~91.5m for 5 seats). Gondiya=Gondia.

original_coverage_E: Bhopal, Sehore, Raisen, Narsimhapur plus Sagar division and Bundelkhand (Sagar, Damoh, Panna, Chhatarpur, Tikamgarh, Niwari)
coverage_T: India (Madhya Pradesh (Bhopal, Sehore, Raisen, Narsimhapur, Sagar, Damoh, Panna, Tikamgarh, Niwari, Chhatarpur ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Redrawn: Vidisha/Rajgarh/Harda/Hoshangabad/Betul moved out; Sagar, Damoh, Panna and Bundelkhand districts added so Vindhya seat is not oversized.
notes: Contiguous via Raisen-Sagar and Sagar-Tikamgarh/Chhatarpur. Niwari carved from Tikamgarh in 2018; Tikamgarh/Niwari split of the 2011 count is estimated.

original_coverage_E: Indore, Dewas, Ujjain, Shajapur, Agar (Agar Malwa), Rajgarh and Dhar districts of the Malwa plateau
coverage_T: India (Madhya Pradesh (Indore, Dewas, Ujjain, Shajapur, Agar, Rajgarh, Dhar ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Ujjain added (old seat 43 Ujjain-Nimar); Rajgarh and Dhar added; Ratlam moved to seat 43.
notes: Agar is 2013 carve-out of Shajapur (estimated split). Contiguous.

original_coverage_E: Nimar and the Narmada valley: Khargone, Barwani, Khandwa, Burhanpur, Harda, Hoshangabad (Narmadapuram), Betul, plus Bhil districts Jhabua, Alirajpur and Ratlam
coverage_T: India (Madhya Pradesh (Ratlam, Jhabua, Alirajpur, Barwani, Khargone, Khandwa, Burhanpur, Harda, Hoshangabad, Betul ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Renamed (old: Ujjain-Nimar); Ujjain moved to seat 42; Ratlam, Harda, Hoshangabad, Betul added.
notes: Contiguous as a chain: Ratlam-Jhabua-Alirajpur-Barwani-Khargone-Khandwa-Burhanpur, with Harda, Hoshangabad and Betul along the Narmada. Khargone=West Nimar, Khandwa=East Nimar in geoBoundaries.

original_coverage_E: Gwalior-Chambal region (Sheopur, Morena, Bhind, Gwalior, Datia, Shivpuri, Guna, Ashoknagar) plus Vidisha
coverage_T: India (Madhya Pradesh (Sheopur, Morena, Bhind, Gwalior, Datia, Shivpuri, Guna, Ashoknagar, Vidisha ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Vidisha added; Bundelkhand districts (Tikamgarh, Niwari, Chhatarpur) go to seat 41.
notes: Contiguous (Ashoknagar-Vidisha).

original_coverage_E: Vindhya Pradesh and Mahakoshal east: Rewa, Satna, Sidhi, Singrauli, Shahdol, Umaria, Anuppur, Katni, Jabalpur, Dindori, Mandla
coverage_T: India (Madhya Pradesh (Jabalpur, Katni, Dindori, Mandla, Rewa, Satna, Sidhi, Singrauli, Shahdol, Umaria, Anuppur ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Seoni, Chhindwara, Narsimhapur, Damoh, Panna, Chhatarpur, Sagar moved to seats 34/41; old flat 18.6m figure replaced.
notes: Contiguous.

original_coverage_E: Jaipur, Ajmer and Sikar districts
coverage_T: India (Rajasthan (Jaipur, Ajmer, Sikar ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Dausa moved to seat 52; Sikar and Ajmer added; Tonk moved to seat 56.
notes: Jaipur ~9.2m. Contiguous (Jaipur borders Ajmer and Sikar).

original_coverage_E: Alwar, Bharatpur, Dhaulpur, Karauli and Dausa districts of east Rajasthan
coverage_T: India (Rajasthan (Alwar, Bharatpur, Dhaulpur, Karauli, Dausa ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Bharatpur, Dhaulpur, Karauli, Dausa added.
notes: Contiguous. Dhaulpur=Dholpur.

original_coverage_E: Jodhpur, Pali, Jalor, Sirohi, Barmer, Jaisalmer (Rajasthan) plus Banas Kantha district of Gujarat (Palanpur, Deesa, Tharad, Vav)
coverage_T: India (Gujarat (Banas Kantha ADM2 only), Rajasthan (Jodhpur, Pali, Jalor, Sirohi, Barmer, Jaisalmer ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Banas Kantha (Gujarat) added to relieve oversized Gujarat seat 61.
notes: Cross-state: Banas Kantha shares the Marwari-speaking borderland of Sirohi/Jalor/Barmer (Palanpur-Abu Road ties). Contiguous via Sirohi/Jalor/Barmer borders. Nagaur kept in seat 54.

original_coverage_E: Bikaner, Churu, Ganganagar, Hanumangarh, Jhunjhunun and Nagaur districts of north and north-west Rajasthan
coverage_T: India (Rajasthan (Bikaner, Churu, Ganganagar, Hanumangarh, Jhunjhunun, Nagaur ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Jhunjhunun and Nagaur added; Jaisalmer moved to Marwar seat 53.
notes: Nagaur is culturally Marwar but placed here for balance. Jhunjhunun=Jhunjhunu. Contiguous.

original_coverage_E: Mewar and southern Rajasthan (Udaipur, Rajsamand, Chittorgarh, Pratapgarh, Banswara, Dungarpur) plus Neemuch and Mandsaur of western Madhya Pradesh
coverage_T: India (Rajasthan (Udaipur, Rajsamand, Chittaurgarh, Pratapgarh, Banswara, Dungarpur ADM2 only), Madhya Pradesh (Neemuch, Mandsaur ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Bhilwara moved to seat 56; Neemuch and Mandsaur (MP) added.
notes: Cross-state: Neemuch and Mandsaur border Chittorgarh/Pratapgarh and share the Mewar-Malwa cultural zone; helps balance MP. Chittaurgarh=Chittorgarh.

original_coverage_E: Hadoti and neighbours: Kota, Bundi, Baran, Jhalawar, Tonk, Bhilwara, Sawai Madhopur
coverage_T: India (Rajasthan (Kota, Bundi, Baran, Jhalawar, Tonk, Bhilwara, Sawai Madhopur ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Tonk, Bhilwara, Sawai Madhopur added because Hadoti alone is only ~7m.
notes: Contiguous (Bundi borders Tonk, Bhilwara, Sawai Madhopur).

original_coverage_E: Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Mahesana, Patan, Sabar Kantha, Aravali and Surendranagar districts
coverage_T: India (Gujarat (Ahmadabad, Gandhinagar, Mahesana, Patan, Sabar Kantha, Aravali, Surendranagar ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Banas Kantha moved to Rajasthan Marwar seat 53; Sabar Kantha, Aravali, Mahesana, Patan, Surendranagar included; Kheda/Anand to seat 63.
notes: Botad carve-out from Ahmedabad (Ranpur/Barwala) estimated at ~150k in 2011. Names Ahmadabad, Aravali follow geoBoundaries.

original_coverage_E: Surat, Tapi, The Dangs, Navsari, Valsad, Bharuch, Narmada districts of Gujarat plus Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
coverage_T: India (Gujarat (Surat, Tapi, The Dangs, Navsari, Valsad, Bharuch, Narmada ADM2 only), Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Bharuch and Narmada added; Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu (UT) added.
notes: Daman and Dadra & Nagar Haveli border Valsad; Diu is a UT exclave off Gir Somnath (Saurashtra), reachable only by sea/road via Saurashtra, accepted because the UT is one ADM1 and cannot be split (long-ish link, flagged). Surat 2026 estimate ~9.2m reflects heavy in-migration.

original_coverage_E: Vadodara, Chhota Udaipur, Panch Mahals, Mahisagar, Dohad, Kheda, Anand districts
coverage_T: India (Gujarat (Vadodara, Chhota Udaipur, Panch Mahals, Mahisagar, Dohad, Kheda, Anand ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Bharuch/Narmada moved to seat 62.
notes: Contiguous. Mahisagar, Chhota Udaipur carved from Panchmahal/Kheda and Vadodara; 2011 split estimated.

original_coverage_E: Kachchh and Saurashtra peninsula: Kachchh, Morbi, Rajkot, Jamnagar, Devbhumi Dwarka, Porbandar, Junagadh, Gir Somnath, Amreli, Bhavnagar, Botad
coverage_T: India (Gujarat (Kachchh, Morbi, Rajkot, Jamnagar, Devbhumi Dwarka, Porbandar, Junagadh, Gir Somnath, Amreli, Bhavnagar, Batod ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Surendranagar moved to seat 61.
notes: Kachchh links to Morbi across the Little Rann (land border). Botad appears as Batod in geoBoundaries.

original_coverage_E: Chhattisgarh plains south and west: Raipur, Gariaband, Dhamtari, Durg, Balod, Bemetra, Rajnandgaon, Kabeerdham, plus Bastar division (Bastar, Kondagaon, Kanker, Dantewada, Bijapur, Sukma, Narayanpur)
coverage_T: India (Chhattisgarh (Raipur, Gariaband, Dhamtari, Durg, Balod, Bemetra, Rajnandgaon, Kabeerdham, Bastar, Kondagaon, Uttar Bastar Kanker, Dakshin Bastar Dantewada, Bijapur, Sukma, Narayanpur ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Bastar region moved here from seat 84 (it links to Dhamtari/Kanker, not to Bilaspur); Baloda Bazar and Mahasamund moved to seat 84.
notes: Raipur/Baloda Bazar/Gariaband split of 2011 undivided Raipur estimated. Bemetra = Bemetara, Kabeerdham = Kawardha; Bastar-Dhamtari/Kanker-Rajnandgaon contiguity verified.

original_coverage_E: North and east Chhattisgarh: Bilaspur, Mungeli, Gaurella-Pendra-Marwahi, Janjgir-Champa, Korba, Raigarh, Jashpur, Surguja, Surajpur, Balrampur, Koriya, plus Baloda Bazar and Mahasamund
coverage_T: India (Chhattisgarh (Bilaspur, Mungeli, Gaurella Pendra Marwahi, Janjgir-Champa, Korba, Raigarh, Jashpur, Surguja, Surajpur, Balrampur, Koriya, Baloda Bazar, Mahasamund ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Renamed (old: Bastar-Bilaspur); Bastar moved to seat 83; Baloda Bazar and Mahasamund added.
notes: Contiguous. Sub-division of 2011 districts into new ones estimated (Surguja/Surajpur/Balrampur, Bilaspur/Mungeli/GPM).
